supersedes: aethervsr.m6-selection/1, whose seed set predated the committed rule
provenanceNote: The first final seed set was invalid: two of its five seeds were byte-identical to models already committed 42 seconds before the rule, and one of those was the selected candidate. Independent review caught it. Seeds 11-15 were trained afterwards, under the corrected step-based schedule, and every one postdates the rule commit.

training.lrSchedule: cosine over optimizer updates (T_max = step budget)

seedProtocol.rule: highest validation mean; ties within 0.01 dB go to the lowest seed number

confirmationSetStatus: Will be read a SECOND time for this candidate. The first read scored the superseded candidate; both reads are reported.
